title: Steering Externalities: Benign Activation Steering Unintentionally Increases Jailbreak Risk for Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the 'safety margin' of Large Language Models and their susceptibility to jailbreaks. It evaluates the models' ability to refuse harmful queries using benchmarks like HarmBench and datasets like BeaverTails, which is a core component of benchmarking AI safety and ethical alignment.
